title: Contract Acceptance Score and Auto-Response Templates for Regional Indemnity Variants
creator: Maya Thompson
description:
Problem: Sales needs a deterministic, auditable path for accepting MSA/DPA redlines that affect indemnity and liability tiers across regions. Legal triage is overloaded; sales loses deals or escalates every small concession, increasing cycle time and blocking Dedicated/Private deals.

Goal: Deliver a Contract Acceptance Scorecard (CAS) that automatically categorizes redlines into Accept / Conditional-Accept / Escalate, plus a set of auto-response templates for the sales team and an API endpoint for programmatic scoring. The scorecard will incorporate region-specific liability ceilings, indemnity language variants, and pricing signal adjustments so sales can provide near-instant pricing guidance and required approvals.

Scope:
- Define scoring heuristics for common redline classes (indemnity cap, mutual indemnity exceptions, escrow, data processing scope, subprocessor clauses).
- Implement template library (email + clause language) for Conditional-Accept paths that include a pre-approved pricing adjustment (e.g., surcharge percentage or commit term) and required legal artifacts.
- Build a lightweight scoring API MVP (read-only) that returns score, rationale tags, and suggested approval path.
- Integrate scoring into the contract intake UI used by Sales (lightweight widget linking to score and suggested template).
- Telemetry: capture score distribution, time-to-decision, approval escalations, win-rate impact, and average pricing concession.

Out of scope for MVP: fully automated redline edits into the MSA text; complex bespoke negotiation flows requiring external counsel.

Acceptance criteria:
- CAS returns a score and one of Accept/Conditional-Escalate/Escalate for 95% of standard redline inputs (legal test set of 120 examples).
- Template library contains at least 6 Conditional-Accept templates covering the common indemnity and liability variations for NA and EU.
- Sales widget shows score and one-click template insertion link; average Sales training time < 45 minutes.
- Telemetry dashboard (Console) shows score distribution and a cohort comparison for deals closed with/without concessions.

Success metrics (first 90 days):
- 30% reduction in legal triage tickets for low-to-medium risk redlines.
- 20% faster median contract turnaround time for mid-market deals.
- Track delta in realized pricing concession when Conditional-Accept templates are used vs manual approvals.

Implementation notes and trade-offs:
- We will use rule-based heuristics for MVP (regex + clause keyword mapping + region-aware thresholds). ML/NLP will be future work once we gather labeled examples.
- Keep scoring deterministic and explainable for Legal to review; store rationale tags for audit.
- Templates must be tradable across regions with localized placeholders and guidance for Sales on when to apply regional limits.

Rollout plan: 
1) Draft heuristics and templates with Legal (2 weeks). Create canonical test set of 120 representative redlines (from historical tickets + anonymized customer samples).
2) Engineering implements scoring API (ENG-44112) and Sales widget integration (2 sprints).
3) Pilot with two Sales reps and Legal reviewer on 10 live deals (2 weeks). Capture telemetry and feedback.
4) Iterate and expand templates to cover APAC language variants.
5) Full launch and training with Sales + Solutions Engineers; update Contract intake docs and runbook.

Risk and mitigation:
- Legal pushback on automation: mitigation = deterministic logs, manual override, and clear escalation paths.
- Mis-scoring leading to financial exposure: mitigation = conservative thresholds for Accept and mandatory Legal sign-off for Escalate scores; escrow/indemnity changes flagged for Finance review.

Related artifacts:
- Confluence PRD: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PM/pages/EC-Contract-Acceptance-Scorecard (draft)
- Example template folder (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-example-templates
- Scoring test set (anonymized): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1TestsetExample
- ENG ticket for scoring API: ENG-44112
- Sales enablement deck (internal): https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1SalesDeckExample

Next steps: finalize scoring thresholds with Legal, start ENG-44112 sprint, schedule pilot with Sales for 2025-03-17.
